The structural collapse is extreme; the object resembles a melted instrument rather than a rigid can. The perceptual_quality_auditor found no noise/blur, but this does not negate the catastrophic structural artifacts. I agree with the Router's severity ratings; the defects are fundamental to the subject's existence.
